<!-- What cannot be done today, or what goes wrong, for whom?

## Fit with the house rules

<!-- CONTRIBUTING.md lists them; the short version:
     - standard library only — does this need any dependency?
     - fail closed — what does the change do with malformed input?
     - trusted core stays small — can this live in evaluations/ or
       examples/ instead of autoproteus/ or controller/?
     - app-specific integrations are kept outside the core until the
       post-v1 extension library; is this one of those? -->

## Evidence plan

<!-- What would demonstrate the change works? Which tests, which suite

     believable — and what result would make you withdraw the proposal? -->
